notes: Speedrunner's Shopping List: Ammo efficient add clear (good for: all S21 raids and dungeons)

[YeezyGT's S15] (PvE): [MW: Velocity] "Martyr's Retribution's purple cousin. Currently the only usable Wave Frame Special Grenade Launcher, with a bit of a mixed perk pool. Surplus/Threat Detector make for great rapid-fire kill capabilities, turning handling/reload speed up to 11. Auto-Loading Holster is great as always. Rampage is a weird one on this, as the kill-recognition is still a bit bugged almost a year later. To be perfectly honest, almost any roll will work on this, none truly transform the gun away from its core functionality."
